about_the_game:
Spin the teapot!

Click the teapot to spin it- it’s that simple. The teapot uses velocity-based physics, so the more you click, the faster the teapot will spin, and the quicker you can get those juicy upgrades- keep clicking that teapot!

Buy powerful upgrades!

From the humble Pottery Wheel to the powerful Gas Station, Teapot Spinner features a wide variety of upgrades to enhance your teapot spinning experience. Use your spins to purchase these, and watch as your teapot spinning rates multiply. Each upgrade has a unique feature to affect the teapot- collect them all and find the best way to spin that teapot, or customize your teapot with the paints and canvas. There may even be a way to spin back in time…

Collect them all!

It’s not just about making the number go up- Teapot Spinner features an incredible amount of achievements for you to earn. Each achievement tree tells a story, and with over 80 of them to unlock, Teapot Spinner ensures that you will keep coming back to spin even more. Can you find them all?
